text: Two. Are you okay? You look a bit fed up. I've just got the results of my English test. Oh dear. What did you get? A six. And I needed a 6.5 to do a Masters. Oh no. I'm sorry. But you worked so hard. I was sure you'd get at least a seven. I know. I was so stupid. I misread one of the questions. That probably lowered my score. Oh dear. So what are you going to do now? It depends. I'm going to ring the course leader and see if they'll accept me with a six. If they don't accept me on the course, I'll either retake the test or I might look for another masters.
